name: NASCAR Race Leaderboard
description: Shows live NASCAR lap status, favorite driver position, and leaderboard pages for Cup, O'Reilly, and Truck Series races.
author: Crazzybrad

api_requirements.name: NASCAR public live feed
api_requirements.description: Unauthenticated NASCAR live timing feed used for race status and running order.
api_requirements.rate_limit: Configurable; defaults to 15 seconds while a selected series is live.

api_requirements.name: NASCAR public schedule feed
api_requirements.description: Unauthenticated season schedule used when there is no active live leaderboard.
